title: Ghanaians repatriated from South Africa after anti-immigrant protests
summary: Almost 300 Ghanaian nationals returned home on Wednesday after waves of anti-immigrant protests in South Africa heightened safety concerns. The group, which included children, boarded a flight from Johannesburg to Accra in what ​authorities described as ‌a voluntary repatriation process for Ghanaian citizens who say they no longer feel safe.
